title: The Sun: Let what is good be seen

quickTake.upright: Things are clearer and your energy is back. Give real progress its due.
quickTake.reversed: The good is still there, but your spark may be low, or optimism may be running ahead of you.

hook: The child is in front of the wall, arms spread, as though happiness no longer needs to be hidden.

sections.title: Sunlight brings the figures forward
sections.bodyMarkdown:
An enormous golden sun fills the upper half of the card. Its face looks straight out, with alternating straight and wavy rays spreading around it. Below, a naked child sits on a white horse, wearing a floral crown with one red feather. Both arms extend outwards. A large red banner on the right billows in curves. The horse faces the viewer; neither reins nor a saddle are visible.

Behind horse and child stands a grey brick wall, with four sunflowers rising above it. The wall remains, but does not stand between the figures and us. Sun, red banner and outstretched arms keep drawing the eye from the background into the foreground. The child’s nakedness can suggest openness and ease, but the picture cannot establish that being completely unguarded is always safe. [View the Sun](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:RWS_Tarot_19_Sun.jpg).

sections.title: Direct light and a child’s simplicity
sections.bodyMarkdown:
In Part II, Waite contrasts the Sun’s direct light with reflected light. Through the child, he discusses simplicity, innocence and renewed consciousness. His account has a distinctly spiritual context and cannot be reduced to “luck in achieving success”. [Waite on the Sun](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktar19.htm).

The upright entry in Part III includes material happiness and contentment. The reversal carries those same meanings in a lesser degree. This offers a useful lesson: a reversal need not overturn the upright meaning. Brightness may simply be diminished for a time. [Waite’s original meanings](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pkt0303.htm).

sections.title: Recognise progress and its limits
sections.bodyMarkdown:
DestinyPixel reads the upright card as greater clarity and a willingness to participate in life. Something has been talked through, effort has received a response, or you finally acknowledge something you have accomplished. It can be a good moment to share results, express needs plainly, and enjoy happiness already present. The brightness invites you to see fully; it does not require painting every unresolved issue gold.

Reversed, tiredness may mute pleasure, or fear of judgement may make you reluctant to show your work. It can also suggest overconfidence and a rush to declare victory. These situations need different responses. One calls for time to take good news in; the other calls for another look at details and other people’s feedback. Recognising the actual situation is more useful than memorising “the Sun has turned bad”.

sections.title: In everyday situations
sections.bodyMarkdown:
**Learning.** In a presentation, you finally explain something you had struggled with. Celebrate, and note which practice helped, so that the progress remains useful later.

**Relationships.** Both of you talk through a misunderstanding, and you no longer have to guess what the other person means. Enjoy the relief, while carrying your new agreements into everyday interactions.

**A team.** The result receives praise, but someone still does not understand how to use it. Reversed, the card can suggest pausing the celebration to check the instructions. Equally, one remaining improvement does not cancel everything the team has achieved.

sections.title: Try it for yourself
sections.bodyMarkdown: Record one thing that has genuinely improved today, give the evidence, and finish the sentence “What helped this happen was…”. Consider thanking someone involved. Give happiness a concrete focus, and preserve the method that worked.

sections.title: Common misreadings
sections.bodyMarkdown: The child is not a pregnancy indicator, and the Sun does not guarantee success in an exam, marriage or project. Joy need not borrow from the future. Using this card to illuminate progress already made is enough.

sections.title: Read these cards together
sections.bodyMarkdown:
- The Moon: Compare guessing in unclear circumstances with information and expression becoming clearer.
- The Star: Distinguish gradually rebuilding hope from expressing vitality and joy.
- The World: Compare a bright stretch of progress with the completion of a defined stage.

articleMarkdown:
# XIX The Sun: Let what is good be seen

**Upright, at a glance:** Things are clearer and your energy is back. Give real progress its due.

**Reversed, at a glance:** The good is still there, but your spark may be low, or optimism may be running ahead of you.

Keywords: Clarity · Vitality · Joy

The child is in front of the wall, arms spread, as though happiness no longer needs to be hidden.

## Sunlight brings the figures forward

An enormous golden sun fills the upper half of the card. Its face looks straight out, with alternating straight and wavy rays spreading around it. Below, a naked child sits on a white horse, wearing a floral crown with one red feather. Both arms extend outwards. A large red banner on the right billows in curves. The horse faces the viewer; neither reins nor a saddle are visible.

Behind horse and child stands a grey brick wall, with four sunflowers rising above it. The wall remains, but does not stand between the figures and us. Sun, red banner and outstretched arms keep drawing the eye from the background into the foreground. The child’s nakedness can suggest openness and ease, but the picture cannot establish that being completely unguarded is always safe. [View the Sun](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:RWS_Tarot_19_Sun.jpg).

## Direct light and a child’s simplicity

In Part II, Waite contrasts the Sun’s direct light with reflected light. Through the child, he discusses simplicity, innocence and renewed consciousness. His account has a distinctly spiritual context and cannot be reduced to “luck in achieving success”. [Waite on the Sun](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktar19.htm).

The upright entry in Part III includes material happiness and contentment. The reversal carries those same meanings in a lesser degree. This offers a useful lesson: a reversal need not overturn the upright meaning. Brightness may simply be diminished for a time. [Waite’s original meanings](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pkt0303.htm).

## Recognise progress and its limits

DestinyPixel reads the upright card as greater clarity and a willingness to participate in life. Something has been talked through, effort has received a response, or you finally acknowledge something you have accomplished. It can be a good moment to share results, express needs plainly, and enjoy happiness already present. The brightness invites you to see fully; it does not require painting every unresolved issue gold.

Reversed, tiredness may mute pleasure, or fear of judgement may make you reluctant to show your work. It can also suggest overconfidence and a rush to declare victory. These situations need different responses. One calls for time to take good news in; the other calls for another look at details and other people’s feedback. Recognising the actual situation is more useful than memorising “the Sun has turned bad”.

## In everyday situations

**Learning.** In a presentation, you finally explain something you had struggled with. Celebrate, and note which practice helped, so that the progress remains useful later.

**Relationships.** Both of you talk through a misunderstanding, and you no longer have to guess what the other person means. Enjoy the relief, while carrying your new agreements into everyday interactions.

**A team.** The result receives praise, but someone still does not understand how to use it. Reversed, the card can suggest pausing the celebration to check the instructions. Equally, one remaining improvement does not cancel everything the team has achieved.

## Try it for yourself

Record one thing that has genuinely improved today, give the evidence, and finish the sentence “What helped this happen was…”. Consider thanking someone involved. Give happiness a concrete focus, and preserve the method that worked.

## Common misreadings

The child is not a pregnancy indicator, and the Sun does not guarantee success in an exam, marriage or project. Joy need not borrow from the future. Using this card to illuminate progress already made is enough.

## Read these cards together

- The Moon: Compare guessing in unclear circumstances with information and expression becoming clearer.
- The Star: Distinguish gradually rebuilding hope from expressing vitality and joy.
- The World: Compare a bright stretch of progress with the completion of a defined stage.

## Sources and further reading

- A. E. Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, Part II, XIX: [English text](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktar19.htm)
- The same book, Part III, Section 3, entry 19: [original upright and reversed meanings](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pkt0303.htm)
- Pamela Colman Smith, RWS card: [Commons image and version history](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:RWS_Tarot_19_Sun.jpg)

The English transcription is dated 1911; the image page identifies the card as Pam-A, 1910. The visual description follows the downloaded Commons JPG. The modern quick takes and exercises are DestinyPixel's original interpretations. Sources checked: 2026-10-07.

sourceRecord.hook: 孩子来到墙的前面，张开手臂，仿佛终于不用躲着表达高兴。

quickTake.upright: 事情明朗了，有劲了，好的进展可以大方承认
quickTake.reversed: 好的一面还在，只是热情不足，或开心得有点过头

sections.title: 阳光把人物推到前景
paragraphs: 巨大的金色太阳占据上半张牌，正面的脸望向外面，直线和波浪形光芒向四周展开。下方的孩子裸身坐在白马上，头上戴着花冠和一根红色羽毛，双臂向两侧伸开；右侧的大红旗卷起波浪般的弧线。白马的头朝向观者，画面看不到缰绳或马鞍。
孩子与马身后是一道灰色砖墙，四朵向日葵从墙后探出头来。墙还存在，却没有挡在人物与我们之间。太阳、鲜红旗帜、向外伸的手臂，让视线不断从背景回到前景。裸体在这里可以引出坦然与无遮掩的阅读，但“毫无防备一定安全”并不是图画能证明的事。[查看太阳牌面](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:RWS_Tarot_19_Sun.jpg)。

sections.title: 直接的光与孩子的简单
paragraphs: Waite 第二部把太阳的直接之光，与反射的光作对比；他从孩子的形象谈到简单、天真和更新后的意识。这套解释带有明确的精神性语境，不能全压缩成“成功运”。[Waite 的太阳篇](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktar19.htm)。
第三部的正位占辞包括物质幸福和满足，逆位则写成相同意义的较弱程度。这提供了一个很实用的学习提醒：逆位不必把正位完全推翻，光亮也可能只是暂时被削弱。[Waite 的原占辞](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pkt0303.htm)。

sections.title: 承认进展，也看清它的边界
paragraphs: DestinyPixel 把正位读作更清楚、更愿意参与生活的状态。事情说开了，努力得到反馈，或你终于肯承认自己做成了一件事。此时可以分享成果、坦白需求，享受已经存在的快乐。画面的明亮鼓励充分看见，不要求你把仍有问题的部分也涂成金色。
逆位可以是疲惫使快乐变淡，担心被评价而不敢展示，也可以是自信过满、太急着宣布胜利。两种情况需要相反的动作：前者允许自己慢一点领会好消息，后者多看一次细节和他人的反馈。辨认实际处境，比把它背成“太阳变坏了”有用。

situations.title: 学习
situations.text: 一次展示终于讲清了原来卡住的内容。可以庆祝，也记下究竟是哪种练习奏效，让这份进步以后还能用得上。

situations.title: 关系
situations.text: 双方把先前的误会说开，你不再靠猜测了解对方。轻松值得享受，同时把新的约定落实到往后的相处里。

situations.title: 团队
situations.text: 成果受到好评，但有人仍不理解如何使用。逆位可提醒你放慢庆功，检查说明是否清楚；也别因为一处待改，就否认大家已经完成的工作。

sourceRecord.practice: 记录一件今天确实变好的事，写明证据，再补一句“帮助它发生的是……”。可以向相关的人表达感谢，让高兴有具体的对象，也让有效的方法留下来。
sourceRecord.commonMisread: 孩子不等于怀孕信号，太阳也不保证考试、婚姻或项目一定成功。快乐不必预支未来；把这张牌用来照亮已有的进展，就已经足够。

relatedCards.reason: 对照不清楚时的猜测，与信息和表达变得明朗。
区分慢慢养回希望，与把活力和喜悦向外表达。
比较一段明亮的进展，与有明确边界的阶段完成。
